shipped_rows.title_o: Individual differences in simultaneous perceptual compensation for coarticulatory and lexical cues

blind_target.authors: Giovannone, N., and Theodore, R. M.
blind_target.title: Do individual differences in lexical reliance reflect states or traits?
blind_target.evidence_quote: Indeed, Giovannone & Theodore (2023) found in both sessions of their Ganong task that individuals who showed greater lexical effect used continuum VOT less during category identification. Results from Task 2 (Ganong Task) of the current experiment found the same pattern. However, in Task 1, we instead found a positive relationship (consistent with the original study). Thus, the findings are again mixed on whether there is a general pattern of trading-off high level information and acoustic information across individuals.
